title: Psychology Paper 4: Stress, Attitudes and Personality Basics
source: Adapted from user-provided Psychology stress and personality sets

objective.question: People's reaction to a stressful event is:
objective.explanation: Stressor is the event; stress response is the reaction.

objective.question: Negative feelings towards a group of people is:
objective.explanation: Prejudice is a negative evaluative attitude.

objective.question: An unconscious stress coping mechanism includes:
objective.explanation: Displacement and regression are defences.

objective.question: In the primary stage of socialization learning takes place:
objective.explanation: Primary socialization is in the family/home.

objective.question: Abnormal psychology is a branch of psychology that deals with:
objective.explanation: Abnormal psychology studies atypical patterns.

objective.question: An extrovert is described as:
objective.explanation: Extroversion links with sociability and impulsivity.

objective.question: Defence mechanism which transfers an emotion from one situation to another is:
objective.explanation: Displacement redirects emotion to a substitute.

objective.question: From the sociological perspective, status is:
options: The social prestige that goes with a role
Determined at the oral and anal stage
objective.explanation: Status is prestige attached to a role.

objective.question: Stages of psychosexual development include:
objective.explanation: Oral, anal, phallic, latency and genital.

objective.question: The following is an emotional reaction to illness except:
objective.explanation: Anger, denial and fear are common; joy is not.

objective.question: In the psychodynamic approach, behaviour is determined by:
objective.explanation: Psychodynamic theory emphasizes unconscious forces.

objective.question: Integrity in health professionals promotes the following except:
objective.explanation: Potency is unrelated to integrity.

objective.question: The branch linked with mental-health work in this set is termed as ____ psychology.
objective.explanation: Clinical psychology covers mental-health care.

objective.question: Crawling is also one of the stages of growth.
objective.explanation: Crawling is a gross-motor milestone.

objective.question: Dementia means ability to remember all events of the past.
objective.explanation: Dementia involves cognitive impairment.

objective.question: Prejudice is feeling good towards somebody.
objective.explanation: Prejudice is negative evaluation.

objective.question: An attitude is sometimes defined as the mental readiness to react towards a stimulus.
objective.explanation: Attitude is a readiness to respond.

objective.question: A genius is also termed as a supra normal person.
objective.explanation: Genius is described as supernormal ability.

objective.question: Prejudice is synonymous with mores.
objective.explanation: Mores are moral customs.

objective.question: Justifying a wrong thing is a form of displacement.
objective.explanation: Justifying is rationalization.

structured.question: Outline five factors that influence learning. (5 marks)
markingGuide: Five factors such as motivation, practice, feedback: 5 marks.
structured.modelAnswer: Motivation, prior knowledge, practice, feedback and environment.

structured.question: a) Define communication. (1 mark) b) Four characteristics of a good channel. (4 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Communication shares meaning; good channel is clear and reliable.

structured.question: Outline any five branches of psychology. (5 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Clinical, educational, social, developmental and cognitive.

structured.question: Examine five ways people react to stress. (5 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Denial, anger, anxiety, withdrawal and active coping.

structured.question: a) Define stress. (1 mark) b) Four conscious ways of overcoming stress. (4 marks) c) Four examples of illness behaviour. (4 marks)
structured.modelAnswer: Stress is a response to demands; coping and illness behaviour vary.
